comment: Generated by scripts/emc.py from mods/<port>/emc/policy.json. Explicit values for uncraftable jurassicraft items and conversions for machine steps ProjectE cannot see; the FAKE|no_emc conversion never resolves, so excluded items get no EMC. Everything else is derived from recipes by ProjectE.

jurassicraft_plant_cells.comment: An empty syringe used on a bush turns into plant cells.

jurassicraft_dna_synthesizer.comment: The DNA synthesizer fills a test tube with nucleotides and keeps the dinosaur or plant DNA disc.

jurassicraft_embryonic_syringe.comment: The embryonic machine combines dinosaur DNA, a petri dish and an empty syringe.

jurassicraft_embryonic_callus.comment: The embryonic machine combines plant DNA, plant cells in a petri dish and an empty syringe.

jurassicraft_calcification.comment: The embryo calcification machine turns a syringe and a chicken egg into a dinosaur egg.
